svg.text: Three Optimization Pillars — Closed-Loop AlphaEvolve Workflow
What AlphaEvolve Mutates (#EVOLVE-BLOCK) -> How Sandboxed evaluate.py Verifies -> Verified Production Outcome
1. EVOLVED #EVOLVE-BLOCK ARTIFACT
2. SANDBOXED EVALUATOR HARNESS
3. SCORED PRODUCTION OBJECTIVE
PILLAR 1 — CLUSTER SCHEDULING: Slurm Partitions, GKE Custom Compute Classes & Cloud Batch Spillover
Scheduling & Spillover Heuristics
Shape-aware bin-packing, memory right-sizing & DWS routing
Discrete-Event Trace Simulator
Replays 10,000+ multi-queue HPC & AI jobs deterministically
Lower P95 Queue Wait & Waste
Cuts GPU starvation, node fragmentation & OOM retries
PILLAR 2 — HPC CODE OPTIMIZATION: 3D Ewald | N-Body Solvers & CUDA | AVX-512 Compute Kernels
Vectorized & Tiled Solver Kernel
Spatial cell lists, SIMD broadcasts & warp-shuffle tiling
Physics Tolerance & Speed Harness
Gates L2 force error < 1e-6 before timing unseen lattices
Verified Multi-X Kernel Speedup
Higher particles-per-sec at exact numerical precision
PILLAR 3 — DEMAND FORECASTING & RESOURCE ALLOCATION: Multi-Horizon P50+P99 & CUD | DWS | Storage Mix
Quantile Forecaster & Allocator
7d + 90d P50/P99 demand & CUD, Reservation, DWS, NVMe mix
52-Week Rolling-Origin Backtester
Strict Train, Validation & Holdout out-of-sample evaluation
Lower Effective TCO & Zero Stockouts
Balances CUD discounts against 5x capacity shortage risk
